description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerService class, which manages performance tracker data within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to access the DAO and to update performance trackers, including permission checks and exception handling.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerService
classes.description: Service class for managing performance tracker operations, including updates and permission validation.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the PerformanceTrackerDao instance used by the service.

methods.name: updateTracker
methods.description: Updates a performance tracker after verifying owner edit permissions; throws exception if not allowed.
